newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy mkt sees o/n rates easing shortterm.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy mkt sees o/n rates easing shortterm.

text.p: Italy's money market expects the overnight rate to ease slightly in the next month from current levels while a sharper fall is forecast longer term, a study based on implicit forward rates showed.

The study by Bocconi University research arm Igier showed the implicit overnight rate on a one month horizon at 6.83 percent, slightly up on expectations of 6.79 percent a week ago but below an actual market close of 6.98 percent on Thursday, the day on which the study was based.

On a three month horizon, the implicit overnight rate stands at 6.57 percent from 6.62 percent seen a week ago, while a year out the overnight rate is seen at 6.0 percent, 75 basis points under the current 6.75 percent official discount rate.
Two years out the implicit overnight rate is seen at 6.07 percent from 6.28 percent one week ago.

The spread between the implicit Italian overnight rate and the implicit German overnight rate, considered a good indicator of market confidence in Italy's entry in European monetary union, dropped to 157 basis points from 172 bp a week ago.
